messages.body:
<https://airflowsummit.org>

*Dear Apache Airflow Community,*


⏰ Early Bird pricing ends *this weekend! *Lock in your spot in Austin, meet
the Airflow community, and get a look at what’s coming next.

Get Early Bird Ticket <https://airflowsummit.org/tickets/>

*Featured Keynote:*

*Agents are now building production pipelines, but Airflow keeps them in
check. *Join Jordan Kail to learn how AI makes agent-authored workflows
scalable, observable, and safe. *Learn more
<https://airflowsummit.org/keynotes/>*

*Check out the full program, sessions and workshops: *


⚙️ *Dynamic graphs - Airflow for agentic workflows*
<https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2026/dynamic-graphs/>

Airflow meets agentic orchestration. Join Ash Berlin-Taylor from Astronomer
to explore how dynamic graphs unlock advanced reasoning patterns beyond
traditional task mapping.


🛠️ *Enterprise-Grade Airflow Upgrade: Strategies & Deep Dive
<https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2026/enterprise-grade-airflow-upgrade-strategies-deep-dive/>*
Learn in this *workshop* by Waqas Shahid how to modernize and upgrade your
Airflow setup with confidence, no downtime, no guesswork.


Explore Workshops <https://airflowsummit.org/workshops/>

*If you’re traveling to join us, we’ve secured a special rate at the Hyatt
Regency for attendees. <https://airflowsummit.org/venue/> *

We recommend booking early while availability lasts.

*⚠️ Workshop spots and discounted hotel rooms are limited*


Get discounted ticket <https://airflowsummit.org/tickets/>


See you in Austin!

*The Airflow Summit Team*
